name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: One panel at a time behind a labelled list, with full ARIA and arrow keys. SegmentedControl is the compact single choice with no panels. Copy: nouns, not verbs — a tab is a place, not an action. One or two words each, and parallel: "Overview, Findings, People", not "Overview, Show findings, The team".
